coordinateSystem: top-left origin; x grows right; y grows down
revisionReason: Add a body reconstruction region for back and rear-leg pixels hidden by the idle tail; shrink the hard anchor to unoccluded haunch pixels.

attentionHead.role: Only region allowed to change between idle and attention-base.

tailMotion.role: Union area reserved for removing the complete idle tail and writing one raised tail.

bodyReconstruction.role: Restore the complete back, haunch, and rear leg that were occluded by the idle tail.

tailRootAnchor.role: Hard anchor limited to unoccluded haunch pixels.
